scope: replaced automated third-party post screenshots with first-party editorial evidence posters
kept original YouTube thumbnails only for verified public video and standardized them to stable hqdefault assets
added local visual fallbacks so blocked external publishers cannot create blank media cards
made Igor Vepretski the persistent human thread across post, portrait, media and StartOn visuals
distinguished approved public portraits, disclosed 7YA editorial or AI scenes, public video frames and source-linked evidence posters
rebuilt the post and portrait wall with filters for posts, Igor Vepretski and broadcasts
updated the deep media library and compact homepage media chapters to use the same governed visual system
fixed SPA navigation for speaker, media and fulfillment pages and added canonical subpath redirect documents to prevent HTTP 403
fixed a verified missing YouTube max-resolution thumbnail by using stable high-quality thumbnail URLs
updated mobile behavior, SEO release markers and deterministic visual tests
truth_boundaries: an editorial evidence poster is labeled and is not represented as an original post screenshot
an AI or editorial scene is disclosed and is not represented as historical event documentation
a YouTube thumbnail is used only as a public video frame and links to the original source
private Drive, Notion and Gmail URLs remain excluded from the public interface
item-level dated metrics are not summed into an unsupported total reach claim
media outlets remain sources and are not represented as partners
source_note: AppDeploy v79 is the production runtime snapshot. This receipt records the release and QA result; it does not assert that GitHub main is byte-identical to the AppDeploy snapshot.
